title: Laurel's House of Horror
specs: Located in a historic abandoned movie theater with paranormal activity
Largest indoor haunted attraction in the region at 28,000 square feet
Not recommended for children under 10 unless scare-friendly; parental discretion advised
Do not enter if pregnant, have asthma, heart conditions, seizures, mental or physical ailments
No intoxication allowed; guests may be removed for safety reasons
No high heels recommended for escape rooms; wear comfortable clothes
Must arrive 15 minutes before scheduled escape room time; no late admittance after 15 minutes
Escape rooms allow 6-10 players per session; larger groups must book multiple sessions or private parties
Private parties and corporate events available by special reservation

services.name: Escape Room
services.desc: You and your group will experience an entirely unique and challenging escape room experience - hosted in a haunted complex built inside an abandoned movie theater. Escape Rooms are great for friends, families, team-building, and date night. Based on classic 90’s video games, escaping is a fun way to flex your brain muscle. Don’t go to the movies, escape from inside them! Pricing is per person. Watch Video One night only, choose from two escape rooms. Add an interactive haunted house experience with games and a special midnight mayhem. Fireworks at 9:30pm, between the two open sessions.
